days.summary: Rastro, vermut, siesta, Debod at night

days.label: Wed 18

stops.title: Dulles → Madrid (overnight)
stops.note: Lands in Madrid 7:45 AM Sunday.

stops.title: Apartment on Gran Vía (2 nights)
stops.area: Gran Vía, near Plaza de España

stops.title: El Rastro flea market
stops.note: Madrid's huge Sunday flea market, busiest 11 to 2.

stops.title: Vermut at Tasca Barea
stops.note: Madrid's Sunday ritual: around 1 PM locals stop for sweet red vermut on tap with an orange slice and an olive.

stops.title: Lunch at Bar El Boquerón
stops.note: Old-school seafood bar: grilled prawns and anchovies in vinegar.

stops.title: Siesta
stops.note: Sleeping off the overnight flight.

stops.title: Templo de Debod at night
stops.note: A 2nd-century BC Egyptian temple, lit up after dark.

stops.title: Dinner and bars on Calle Ponzano
stops.note: Madrid's busiest local bar street.

stops.title: Royal Palace guided tour
stops.note: English guided tour, 11:45 to 12:45.

stops.title: Lunch at Casa Labra
stops.note: A bar since 1860 with its zinc counter intact, famous for battered salt cod.

stops.title: Cervantes' tomb
stops.note: Cervantes is buried in the Trinitarias convent; his bones were identified in 2015. Literary quotes are set into the pavement nearby.

stops.title: CaixaForum vertical garden
stops.note: A floating brick box beside a living wall of 15,000 plants.

stops.title: Museo del Prado
stops.note: Velázquez, Goya, Bosch.

stops.title: Reina Sofía
stops.note: Guernica, Dalí, Miró and Jean Nouvel's extension.

stops.title: Dinner at La Barra de la Tasquería
stops.note: Michelin Bib Gourmand bar: Madrid tavern food with an adventurous streak.

stops.title: Nightcap at 1862 Dry Bar
stops.note: Quiet classic-cocktail bar on a local street.

stops.title: Pick up the rental car
stops.note: Driving south for four days.

stops.title: Mezquita of Córdoba (closed early)
stops.note: The great mosque-cathedral closed early for a local feast day, so we came back by train on Wednesday.

stops.title: Córdoba Synagogue
stops.note: One of only three medieval synagogues left in Spain. Maimonides' statue is around the corner.

stops.title: Tapas around Plaza de la Alfalfa
stops.note: Cañas standing outside on Plaza del Salvador with locals, then tapas on Plaza de la Alfalfa.

stops.title: Real Alcázar
stops.note: The royal palace and gardens, still used by the Spanish royal family.

stops.title: Train to Córdoba
stops.note: A quick high-speed day trip for a second try at the Mezquita.

stops.title: Mezquita of Córdoba, second try
stops.note: The great mosque-cathedral, a forest of red-and-white arches.

stops.title: Train back to Seville
stops.note: Under an hour back to Seville for the evening.

stops.title: Cocktail at Hotel Alfonso XIII (maybe)
stops.note: Seville's grand 1929 hotel.

stops.title: Dinner at La Barra de Cañabota
stops.note: The casual bar of a Michelin-starred seafood restaurant.

stops.title: Drinks on the Alameda de Hércules
stops.note: Where Seville's 20s and 30s crowd drinks outside late.

stops.title: Plaza de España
stops.note: A quick stop in the morning light on the drive out.

stops.title: Ronda: Puente Nuevo and the gorge
stops.note: The famous bridge over a 100 m gorge, seen from the path below, plus 13th-century Arab baths.

stops.title: Park in Granada, taxi up to the cave house
Cave house in Sacromonte (2 nights)
stops.note: A house carved into the hillside facing the Alhambra.

stops.title: Sunset over the Alhambra
stops.note: The classic Alhambra sunset view.

stops.title: Free-tapa crawl in Realejo
stops.note: In Granada every drink comes with a free tapa; three or four bars makes dinner.

stops.title: Alhambra and Generalife
stops.note: The Nasrid palaces and gardens.

stops.title: Fajalauza ceramics
stops.note: Granada's own green-and-blue glazed pottery, made by the same families for centuries.

stops.title: Dinner at Albidaya
stops.note: Bib Gourmand tasting menu blending Andalusian and Moroccan flavors.

stops.title: Hotel in the Gothic Quarter (2 nights)
Lunch at Mercat de Santa Caterina
stops.note: A neighborhood market under a wave-shaped tile roof; lunch at the family-run Bar Joan.

stops.title: Museu Picasso
stops.note: Five medieval palaces; strongest on his early Barcelona years.

stops.title: Dinner at Oníric
stops.note: A Michelin Bib Gourmand restaurant serving a creative fusion tasting menu.

stops.title: Gràcia's squares after dinner
stops.note: Plaça de la Virreina, then Plaça del Sol, where young locals fill the terraces.

stops.title: Park Güell
stops.note: Gaudí's hillside park.

stops.title: Sagrada Família
stops.note: Gaudí's basilica, still under construction since 1882.

stops.title: Barça vs Villarreal
stops.note: Kickoff 2:00 PM local time.

stops.title: Sunset at the Bunkers del Carmel
stops.note: A Civil War anti-aircraft battery with the whole city below. Sunset at 5:26.

stops.title: Back to the hotel for our bags
Nightcap in Sant Antoni
stops.note: Bar Calders or Els Sortidors del Parlament on Barcelona's local bar street.

stops.title: Check out, leave bags at the hotel
Palau de la Música Catalana
stops.note: Modernista concert hall with a stained-glass skylight.

stops.title: Lunch at DELTA
stops.note: Rice dishes, Arrocería Informal.

stops.title: Family time in Nice
stops.note: Through Saturday Nov 28. Thanksgiving is Thursday Nov 26.

stops.title: Fly home to Los Angeles
stops.note: Lands at LAX 4:35 PM.
